title: Skin anatomy
description: A layered barrier with hair, glands, receptors and its own immune system.

questions.question: What are the main layers of the skin?
questions.answer: The epidermis is the outer epithelial barrier; the vascular dermis contains connective tissue, vessels and nerves. Subcutaneous tissue lies beneath the skin and varies by region.

questions.question: How does skin help protect the body?
questions.answer: The keratinized epidermal surface limits water loss and helps block external injury and microbes, while deeper tissue supports sensation, repair and temperature regulation.

questions.question: What is the stratum corneum?
questions.answer: 15–20 layers of dead, flattened, keratin-filled corneocytes held by lipids — the "brick and mortar" barrier. Function: Waterproofing and the main barrier to microbes and chemicals.

questions.question: Where is the dermis (papillary & reticular) located?
questions.answer: Papillary layer of loose connective tissue forming dermal papillae; reticular layer of dense irregular collagen and elastin. Function: Strength, elasticity, sensation and the vascular supply of the epidermis.

questions.question: What is the function of the hair shaft & follicle?
questions.answer: Function: Protection, sensation and (in other mammals) insulation. A keratinised shaft growing from a follicle that dips into dermis or fat, with a bulb around a dermal papilla and a bulge of stem cells.
